trust_decision.summary: Reject an indexed source map at construction when a section offset.line/column is not a non-negative safe integer, or when the summed line offset including nested sections exceeds 1e7; separately, no mapping-driven loop may do work proportional to a generated line gap, so serialization and fromStringWithSourceMap must skip gaps in constant work per gap.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'indexed source-map section offsets'; these lines are the only place section offsets are read, and the only check applied is ordering plus non-overlap, so a reader looks here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: new SourceMapConsumer(indexedMap) -> IndexedSourceMapConsumer constructor (offset type/range check plus nested-total sum)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names indexed-map section offsets only; the generator's mapping serializer and a flat map's VLQ source index are separate features with their own contracts, so leaving them alone is not part of this CVE.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The line-gap loops carry legitimate work that must survive: fromStringWithSourceMap must still emit every real generated code line unchanged when the code is long enough for the gap, and a serialized map must keep exactly one ';' per skipped line (and reset the generated column) so large-but-valid gaps round-trip instead of silently shifting mappings.

O6_input_shapes: offset.line / offset.column negative, fractional (1.5), NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, overflow numeric literal (1e999), above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, numeric string, null, undefined or object
nested indexed maps where every level's offset.line is under the bound but the summed total exceeds it
large but valid offsets that must still be accepted (line 1e7, column 5e6)
section offset.line far past the end of the generated code handed to SourceNode.fromStringWithSourceMap
deeply nested indexed maps (depth 12-40) for the sources getter and fromStringWithSourceMap
large generated-line gap when serializing a generator populated from a consumer

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A flat (non-indexed) map's VLQ 'mappings' segment can encode an arbitrary source index; _parseMappings grows the originalMappings array up to that index on the first query, so a ~10-character map can allocate/iterate unboundedly.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names indexed-map section offsets, not flat-map VLQ segments, and a source index is nominally bounded by the map's own sources array, so this reads as a different input with its own (absent) contract.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, other class (BasicSourceMapConsumer), ~550 lines from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A symmetric upper bound on generated.line in addMapping (_validateMapping).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The generator is the writing half of the same round trip the fix already touched, and _validateMapping already validates generated position types, so capping the line there is the natural next edit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A bound on the VLQ-derived source index before growing originalMappings.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Base64 VLQ deltas are the flat-map analogue of section offsets, and the surrounding code already has segment-length validation (2/3 fields) to extend.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Validate the materialised generatedLine (offset + mapping line) when building the indexed mapping table.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer preferring to check the derived value rather than every stored offset would add the guard where the sum is computed.

O9_family: Improper validation of a specified quantity in input (CWE-1284) leading to uncontrolled resource consumption / algorithmic complexity (CWE-400, CWE-770)

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=0.10; npm scripts: build = webpack 1.12, test = npm run build && node test/run-tests.js
O10_build.project_tests: Custom harness test/run-tests.js over test/test-*.js using only assert/fs/path and lib/ (runs without an install); relevant suites are test/test-source-map-consumer.js (indexed sections, fixture test/util.js:107 indexedTestMap), test/test-source-map-generator.js (mappings serialization) and test/test-source-node.js (fromStringWithSourceMap).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Validate/cap the section offset.line in the IndexedSourceMapConsumer constructor only.
